IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: router-prod-latency-5m | sev=critical | trigger=router.p95 > 1200ms for 3m. Alert link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345

Sam K: ACK — I'm on it. pulling graphs + traces now to see scope.

PagerDutyBot: Alert acknowledged by Sam K

Maya R: seeing a short spike in us-west-2 router cluster from 12:32:10 -> 12:33:30. p95 peaked ~1.3s. No uptick in 5xx. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc-router

Diego L: quick PromQL check:
```
max_over_time(router_request_duration_seconds{job="router"}[5m])
# observed max: 1.35 at 12:32:45
```

Priya S: Autoscaler added +2 router replicas at 12:33:00; also seeing a burst of kv-cache misses around 12:33:05. Might be cold-KV warmup cascade.

Sam K: any customer-facing errors? quick grep of logs shows latency tail but no 500s or customer error alerts.

OpsBot: No customer tickets linked. RUM sample rate steady.

IncidentBot: Alert auto-resolved (router.p95 below threshold) at 12:34:20 — PagerDuty alert closed.

Sam K: Auto-resolved. I'll sit on watch for 15m to verify no recurrence. Marking as No Customer Impact for now. :white_check_mark:

Priya S: Note added: hypothesis = transient KV cache pressure + autoscaler lag. Follow-up: add KV warmup hints for hot prefixes and consider lowering scaler threshold for short bursts.

Maya R: taking the post-ack watch. Handoff -> Maya R for next 30m. @Sam K handing off :handshake:

Sam K: thanks — leaving the channel. If it pops again, escalate to eng-runtime and page me directly.

Maya R: acknowledged, watching dashboards (+ trace sampling up a notch). Will open ops ticket if it recurs.

PagerDutyBot: PagerDuty alert P12345 marked resolved.

Sam K: quick mitigation notes:
```
- observed: p95 spike to ~1.35s for ~70s
- autoscaler reaction: +2 replicas at t+50s
- kv-cache: spike in misses during warmup window
- customer impact: none observed
- immediate action: monitor 15-30m, no rollback required
- follow-up: add warmup, tweak scaler thresholds
```

Maya R: I'll file a short ops note if we see a repeat, otherwise we'll record this in the incident tracker as transient. Closing thread in 15m unless someone objects.

Priya S: no objections. :+1:

IncidentBot: This thread will be archived unless new messages are posted.
